question: If the other characters had been given the same condition that Reid Astrea presented to Emilia—“If you can move me even a single step, you win!”—would anyone have been able to move him even one step in a normal fight?
answer:
No way.

Even Emilia, who managed to accomplish something under those conditions, normally wouldn't have been able to do it either! It was possible because Emilia was in a special situation, but under normal circumstances, she wouldn't have been able to move Reid even a single step. So I don't think it would have been possible for the members who were there.

If Ram were included and everyone worked together, I feel like they might be able to do something cool like, “After an incredibly fierce and brutal battle, we finally moved him one step!” But I think it would take that much of them giving everything they had just to accomplish it.

One-on-one, though? That's impossible, right?
